description: Find public-records sources (datasets, portals, registers, reports) by question or keywords. Use `place` to include everything covering a place, from the city up to federal and global sources. Returns the publisher, how to get the data (API endpoint or page), update rate, last update, licence and whether we verified it. Not for finding, profiling or screening people.

department.description: Shelf id: water, power, safety, housing, laws, funding, services, transport, environment, health, people, consumer, education, jobs, portals.

place.description: Place id, e.g. 'us-ca-los-angeles', 'us-ca', 'us', 'germany'. Use list_places to find ids.

query.description: What you're looking for, e.g. 'open code enforcement cases' or 'boil water notices'.

name: search_library
title: Search the public record
